requirements.title: ROUND values are UP, DOWN, ZERO, NEAREST, COMPATIBLE, or PROCESSOR_DEFINED
requirements.definition: The scalar default character expression in a ROUND= specifier shall evaluate to UP, DOWN, ZERO, NEAREST, COMPATIBLE, or PROCESSOR_DEFINED.

pending.round-up-value: Positive source/control uses ROUND="UP" in a context admitted by 12.6.2.1; trailing blanks/case-insensitivity remain covered by 12.6.2.1 p4.
pending.round-down-value: Positive source/control uses ROUND="DOWN" in a context admitted by 12.6.2.1; trailing blanks/case-insensitivity remain covered by 12.6.2.1 p4.

pending.round-other-value-source-control: Source-control negative changes only the ROUND= value to an unlisted token such as "MAYBE"; no numbered diagnostic is claimed for this unnumbered value rule.

requirements.title: ROUND temporarily changes the connection input/output rounding mode
requirements.definition: The ROUND= specifier temporarily changes the input/output rounding mode for the connection.

pending.round-temporary-change: Use formatted output or input of a decimal conversion chosen so the named mode changes a non-tie result unambiguously, with SS sign mode and fixed width; after the statement, INQUIRE(ROUND=; 12.10.2.28) prefilled sentinel must report the OPEN mode. Repeat for the other named modes using values whose discarded decimal digits avoid ties unless the mode specifies the tie; PROCESSOR_DEFINED is source-control only because the rounded result is processor dependent.
pending.round-mode-restored-after-statement: The temporary-change plans explicitly pre-establish a nondefault connection mode with OPEN, perform one data transfer with a different statement specifier, and use post-transfer INQUIRE with a nonmatching sentinel to assert restoration rather than merely successful transfer.

requirements.title: Omitted ROUND leaves the connection input/output rounding mode unchanged
requirements.definition: If the ROUND= specifier is omitted, the input/output rounding mode is not changed.

pending.omitted-round-does-not-change-mode: Open with ROUND="NEAREST", perform a transfer omitting ROUND=, initialize INQUIRE variable to a sentinel, and expect INQUIRE(ROUND=; 12.10.2.28) to remain NEAREST.

accounting.rationale: Single paragraph mixes ROUND= value restriction, temporary mode effect/restoration, and omitted-specifier no-change rule.

review_rationale: Source registration for 12.6.2.2-12.6.2.16, the individual io-control-spec specifiers (batch160). Every unit hash-verified by independent reviewers across two rounds. Each temporary mode specifier is split into its value restriction, its one-statement effect with restoration of the connection mode (observed by INQUIRE after the statement), and the omitted-means-unchanged rule. Round 1 found a pending plan expecting exact output from I2 on a positive value without fixing the sign mode; it now uses SS, and a sweep found no other plus-, leading-zero- or rounding-dependent exact output. R1215 and C1232 were pre-accounted. Source accounting only.
